description: [NON-TERMINAL] Schedule a one-time wake-up after a delay. Two modes: (1) action_definitions — provide a list of {process_key, arguments} objects to execute at fire time; (2) memory_tag — the platform retrieves memories with that tag and the model decides what to do next. For scheduled peer notifications use action_definitions with plugin::agent_messaging_plugin::send_peer_message and important=true so the wake fires via the native IMPORTANT path.
embedding_description: Schedule a one-time delayed wake-up after N seconds. Use action_definitions (list of {process_key, arguments}) for direct action dispatch at fire time, or memory_tag for the recall-and-decide pattern. Returns schedule_id and run_at. Use for check-ins, retries, peer wake-ups, and watchdog timeouts.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Schedule ID with delay_seconds and run_at timestamp
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: A delayed execution schedule has been created. Consider whether you should inform the requester when the check-in will occur, and retain the schedule_id or tags so it can be cancelled once work completes.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Scheduling a one-time delayed wake-up keyed by memory_tag
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ParameterError with 'seconds': value must be a positive integer greater than 0. ParameterError with 'memory_tag': missing or empty. ScheduleCreateError: scheduler not initialized or failed to save schedule.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For seconds errors: ensure value is a positive integer. For memory_tag errors: provide a non-empty memory_tag. For scheduler errors: verify scheduler service is running and state service is accessible for persistence.
